Keep the sporty handling and the fuel economy in the next generation

Proposal
1, implement. Sportiness (9.34 vs peer 7.30) and fuel economy (9.30 vs 7.56) are the strongest study advantages; driving dynamics collects 415 likes. Strengths to protect.
Horizon
H2. Applies to the successor generation.
Domain

Markets
EU

Reference

Statement

The successor shall keep the agile handling and the fuel economy that customers praise today.

Acceptance criteria

One row per market where expectations differ. Basis: evidence is a measured study value or a count; assumption is the agent's proposal for the product manager to set.
